title: The string lights going up
logline: Gully's son, thirteen, on a ladder stringing the lights along the shack's eave, Gully holding the ladder from behind, the lawn chair with the box of bulbs on it. Unlit yet. The month before two chairs.

panels.composition: A boy of thirteen on a ladder stringing colored lights along a shingle shack's eave, a heavy gray man holding the ladder from behind, an old lawn chair with a box of bulbs on its seat, dusk.
